steps.prompt: Create an image. Pixel art sprite sheet for a handheld game. The attached image is the existing sprite sheet of this exact character (Thanh Tri, an earth element little castle golem, LEGENDARY (final mythic form) stage). Draw NEW animation frames of the SAME character: identical pixel art style, palette, dark outline, proportions, body shape, colours, markings and accessories, and the same size as in the attached sheet, always facing right. Square canvas 1024x1024, flat solid magenta background #FF00FF everywhere (no gradient, no floor, no shadow, no text, no numbers, no grid lines). NO food, NO props, NO human hands. Grid of 4 columns x 4 rows, one character per cell, centered, the whole character fully inside its cell (nothing cropped), sprites must not touch each other, feet on the same line in every cell except the mid-air frames. Row 1: (1) standing idle exactly like the first frame of the attached sheet; (2) EAT: opening its gate mouth wide; (3) EAT: the food going into its gate; (4) EAT: chewing, its windows glowing. Row 2: (5) EAT: the tiny flag on top waving happily; (6) PLAY: marching like a little soldier; (7) PLAY: stomping in place; (8) PLAY: a tiny jump. Row 3: (9) PLAY: its tower head spinning; (10) PLAY: a heavy landing with dust; (11) PLAY: saluting proudly; (12) REFUSE food: gate mouth slammed shut. Row 4: (13) PETTED: windows glowing warm, eyes closed; (14) WAVE hello: waving a stone hand; (15) SAD: flag drooping, slumped; (16) ANGRY: steam puffing from the tower top.
